relationships.subject: MDGA1
relationships.evidence_quote: The increased levels of GluR1 in the synaptosomal membrane fraction of the ipsilateral dorsal horn tissues at day 7 post-SNL was normalized to near sham level by pretreatment with intrathecal MDGA1 siRNA<sub>2308</sub>

relationships.subject: MDGA1
relationships.evidence_quote: knocking down MDGA1 with siRNAs reduced the mechanical and thermal pain hypersensitivities, and inhibited the increased excitatory synaptic interaction between neuroligin-2 with PSD-95

key_findings: SNL upregulates dorsal horn MDGA1 at day 7.
MDGA1 knockdown reduces pain hypersensitivity, normalizes GluR1 surface levels and neuroligin-2 interactions with PSD-95 and Gephyrin.
